quote: Information extraction (IE) aims to identify and structure user-specified information from unstructured texts . IE tasks are highly diversified due to its varying targets (entity, relation, event, sentiment, etc.)

we propose UIE, a unified text-to-structure generation architecture that can universally model different IE tasks, adaptively generate targeted structures, and collaboratively learn general IE abilities from different knowledge sources.
outputs: structured records in SEL (Structured Extraction Language) format

quote: We use span-based offset Micro-F1 as the primary metric to evaluate the model
